cards.title: Appendix Archive Lab Story Decision Point Card
cards.decisionSkill: name one fictional archive character choice, two possible paper paths, one comparison clue, one chosen path, one consequence note, and one hanging-file label
cards.useCase: Adult-led fictional offline paper-only hanging file decision-point card for a made-up Appendix Archive Lab page: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: set out one hanging file, blank page, pencil, and this card beside a pretend appendix archive tray: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Writer: plan one invented lab character choice on paper and keep every archive detail made up with adult guidance: ____________________.
cards.choicePrompt: Character choice: name the fictional archive helper's choice at the decision point: ____________________.
cards.pathOnePrompt: Path one: write the first possible paper path through a note stack, appendix tab, or file marker: ____________________.
cards.pathTwoPrompt: Path two: write a different possible path using another tab, margin clue, or archive note: ____________________.
cards.compareCluePrompt: Compare clue: name one small clue that helps compare the two paths without blame or danger: ____________________.
cards.chosenPathPrompt: Chosen path: choose the path the helper takes and explain the quiet reason: ____________________.
cards.consequenceNotePrompt: Consequence note: write what changes in the pretend archive after that chosen path: ____________________.
cards.fileLabelPrompt: Hanging-file label: write the broad pretend label for this archive decision point: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: fill only the character choice, two path names, and file label first: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: keep the page with the hanging file and add one new compare clue later: ____________________.
